scenarios.title: Miracle lets a card be cast for its miracle cost only if it is the first card drawn this turn

setup.notes: Library lists the top card first. It is B's turn, so A has not drawn any card this turn yet.

decisions: A casts Inspiration targeting A, tapping the four Islands; B passes and it resolves, so A draws two cards from the top of the library.
If the first drawn card is Thunderous Wrath, A reveals it for miracle; the miracle trigger resolves and A casts it for {R} targeting B's Grizzly Bears, tapping Mountain.
Both players pass; Thunderous Wrath resolves.

variants.label: wrath_drawn_first
variants.expected: A draws Thunderous Wrath first, reveals it, and the miracle trigger fires. Thunderous Wrath is cast for {R}, deals 5 damage to Grizzly Bears, which dies, and Thunderous Wrath is put into A's graveyard. A's hand holds one Island.

variants.label: wrath_drawn_second
variants.delta: A's library order is Island, Thunderous Wrath, Island (top first), so Thunderous Wrath is the second card drawn.
variants.expected: Thunderous Wrath is not the first card drawn this turn, so no miracle trigger fires. It stays in A's hand along with an Island. Mountain stays untapped, but {4}{R}{R} cannot be paid, so it cannot be cast. Grizzly Bears is unharmed.

scenarios.forge_notes: Check that Forge offers miracle for a draw made on the opponent's turn and counts draws per player.
